Author: kittenhaswares-ui
Name: PulseQueue
Punchline: Held input repeats. Latest real press wins.
Description: A newest-input smart buffer with native logical-input Turbo and macro support.
Changelog: Fixes the live failure where ReAction Turbo made PulseQueue inherit ReAction's combo and macro exclusions. PulseQueue now acts as a same-InputId gap-filler: each observed ReAction/native pulse moves the fallback one interval forward, and PulseQueue resumes only when that stream leaves a gap. Outer-hook pulses are coalesced, Auto Target no longer release-gates combo holds, complete macros retain native Macro mode, and the first native press can claim without a startup release. Newest physical input still wins, older holds remain suppressed until release, and the adaptive one-shot buffer maximum is raised from 180 to 350 ms.
